title: Alice in the Digital World
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Given an array of positive integers and a value m, the task is the largest sum of a contiguous subarray whose minimum element equals m and which contains exactly one copy of m. The array holds up to 10^5 entries, each at most 64, and always contains at least one entry equal to m; several datasets follow.
